_proposal.api_submission: Keep this payload disabled until the maintainer verifies signed version-tag behavior on the intended repository plan and explicitly authorizes repository settings changes.

steps: Record the incident, version tag, source commit, and intended recovery in a tracked issue before changing repository rules.
Never delete, move, or reuse an existing version tag; create a new signed annotated version tag only after CI quality aggregate succeeds for the exact commit.
If signing is blocked, verify the configured release signer and allowed-signers file; do not bypass signature validation or retag an existing release.

If an administrative ruleset change is unavoidable, make the smallest time-bounded change through the GitHub ruleset UI or API, capture its audit entry, and restore protection before the next release.
